title: Hyper 3-D Pinball
overview:
This is 3-D Pinball, baby.

It's a whole new world and a whole new way of looking at it.

Make like a giant from a cozy top-down view or get microscopic in a 3-D earthquaking trip that sucks you in one end and shoots you out the other. Right down into a rocketing, head-rattlin' shotgun ride of pure screaming speed. Better learn the flipper mambo fast or it's game over.

These balls and bumpers have got arcade smarts and they're not letting anything slide by without a fight. Hold on tight. This sensory freak-out's jumping with creepy graveyards, dark fantasylands and rat-tat-tat gangsters in not four, not five, but six completely different table-shaking, electro-bumping, ramp-raging worlds.

Don't forget to pack your fingers. You're gonna need 'em.

Includes six finger-blistering tables featuring:
- Hyper-realistic controls and kinetic ball movement based on actual pinball machine physics - with three-angle bumping for the utmost realism
- The only CD-ROM pinball arcade simulation with a full-blown, completely 3-D environment - all rendered on Silicon Graphics systems for eye-popping, mind-blowing action
- Nail home jackpots, sling shots, skill shots, roll-overs and kickbacks as you navigate each table's sweet spots, traps and tricks to a rockin' sensurround soundtrack for a full-on arcade voyage
- Top-down or three-quarter view gives you action your way
- Whiz through jet bumpers, multiple ramps, ramp targets, double return lanes, super spinners, combination bonuses, multiple multi-ball options, hidden areas, dot matrix screens, video modes and much more
